exactText: Manage AXM agent-extension packages and workspace state: skills, subagents, MCP connections, rules, hooks, Knowledge bundles, and packs. limits: The no-skill target was not fully met: two safety/ownership boundaries remain irreducible and retained, with corresponding minimal-skill success. Failures were not reclassified as passes.
The no-skill Hook observation with unsupported grounding remains a separate limitation even though its final factual answer was correct.
Retained conditional validation states concrete claims not proved by current operation receipts; it does not prescribe a universal lint, sync, readback or help sequence.

Only four activation cases and twenty task cases with two repetitions were tested on one model configuration. Reviewers were implementation participants, independent per transcript but neither external nor blinded.
Invalid original apparatus/setup observations were excluded before replacement scoring; the evaluation report preserves supersession and evidence hashes.
Public evidence omits private prompts, transcripts, host paths and credentials. This companion contains repository-relative source references and sanitized case IDs only.
